title: Michelin Power Protection TLR Competition Line
notes: Official size list read 2026-11-01: 28, 30, 32 and 35 mm (-622), each listed for hooked and hookless rims, black or Classic sidewall. Endurance, all-road and e-road use 'to overcome tough road conditions all year round'; Bead to Bead puncture and pinch protection and Magi-X compound.
